summary.title: Lessons
summary.one_liner: The Silverstripe Lessons page says its lessons have been removed for replacement, so this page offers no tutorial content at present.
takeaways: The Silverstripe Lessons page currently has no lesson content; the lessons were removed.
Silverstripe says it intends to replace the removed lessons with up-to-date, relevant ones.
For Silverstripe documentation, the page points to other site sections such as Developer Docs and API Docs in the navigation.
summary.summary: This is the Lessons page on the Silverstripe website. The main text states that the lessons were removed because they were potentially confusing and outdated, and that the organisation intends to replace them with current content. The rest of the page is site navigation, company and cloud platform menus, and footer links, with no tutorial steps or code. Because the page contains no lesson material, it is only useful as a pointer that the old lessons are no longer available.
